description.value: The Foreman's agents have a harder time tracking you specifically; bonus to Stealth and Deception when evading them.

cinderfall.incomplete: 'Bonus to Stealth and Deception when evading them [the Foreman's agents]' names no value and there is no predicate for a specific NPC faction's tracking attempts. The card states a bonus/effect but gives no numeric value or formula to build a rule element from without inventing one.
